svg.title: Wiring diagram: 8-drive build
svg.desc: Colour-coded wiring from the Schurter mains inlet through WAGO splits to the RSP-200-12 and LRS-150F-5, then through the Blue Sea 5026 fuse block (7.5 A) and inline 5 A fuses to Molex pigtails A1 and A2 on the Jonsbo N3 backplane, with a ground bond to the host server.
svg.text: All wire 2.5 mm² H07V-K except the 18 AWG Molex pigtails.
A hop means two wires cross without connecting.
